SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND s.County = 'Fresno';

FROM schools AS T1 
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno County Office of Education' AND T1.Charter = 1;
